title: Annotatio IV §.XXIII: Jn 6:63 + 1 Cor 2:13 — Spirit vivifies; words spirit and life; spiritual things with spiritual
pass_a_gloss: Because We (but taught by Christ Himself that it is the spirit that vivifies, and the flesh profits nothing, Jn 6:63) also believe Him when He warns that the words spoken in this matter are Spirit and Life, and according to the very condition of the Holy Spirit’s Doctrine we decide that these things are to be discerned spiritually, and that Spiritual things are always to be compared with Spiritual, 1 Cor. 2:13.
pass_b_english: We follow Christ’s own teaching (Jn 6:63): the spirit vivifies; the flesh profits nothing — and His warning that the words spoken here are Spirit and Life.
Under the Holy Spirit’s doctrine we discern these things spiritually and always set spiritual things with spiritual (1 Cor. 2:13).
source_text: Quia Nos (sed ab ipso Christo edocti, spiritum esse, qui vivificat, carnemque prodesse nihil, Jo. 6. 63.) etiam & verba, quæ hac in re prolata sunt, Spiritum esse & Vitam, Ipsi monenti credimus, proque conditione ipsâ Doctrinæ S. Spiritus, decernimus, spiritualiter ista discernenda esse, & Spiritualia cum Spiritualibus semper conferenda esse, 1. Cor. 2, 13.
